city-square.name: Poznań City Square
city-square.description: The Poznań City Square. The Town Hall stands in the center, but its heavy doors are locked.

town-hall.name: Town Hall Corridor
town-hall.description: A quiet, carpeted corridor leading to the Mayor's Office.

mayors-office.name: Mayor's Office
mayors-office.description: The grand office of the Mayor of Poznań. Rich oak furniture and the city flag fill the room.

necronomicon.name: The Necronomicon
necronomicon.description: The ancient book of dark magic.

official-stamp.name: Official Library Stamp
official-stamp.description: The library stamp obtained from Director Kowalski.

town-hall-key.name: Town Hall Key Card
town-hall-key.description: A silver keycard used to unlock the Town Hall gates.

clerk.name: Mr. Janusz the Clerk
clerk.description: A weary municipal clerk standing in the city square.

dialogues.before_talk: Mr. Janusz: Sighed... If you want to enter the Town Hall, I need proof you have a stamped authorization from the central library.
dialogues.after_talk: Mr. Janusz: Do you have the official library stamp? Kowalski usually has it.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Mr. Janusz: Perfect! The stamp is authentic. Here is the Town Hall Key Card. Go on in.

mayor.name: Mayor Jaśkowiak
mayor.description: The Mayor of Poznań, who wants the Necronomicon to prevent library leaks.

dialogues.before_talk: Mayor Jaśkowiak: Welcome, biographer. Do you bring the Necronomicon? I will sign your research approval and let you keep it under state supervision.
dialogues.after_talk: Mayor Jaśkowiak: Please, hand over the book so I can sign the approval forms.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Mayor Jaśkowiak: Excellent! Your research is approved, and the book is officially yours to study. You have beaten the bureaucracy!
dialogues.hostile: Mayor Jaśkowiak: Security, throw this traitor out!
